title: clb-8k_20210115.htm
主要内容: Core Laboratories N.V. (CLB US) announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.01 per share, payable in Q1 2021. The dividend will be paid on 16 February 2021 to shareholders of record on 25 January 2021. A total annual payout of $0.04 per share would result if the dividend is maintained. Dutch withholding tax of 15% will apply. Future dividends will depend on the company's financial position, earnings, earnings outlook, capital expenditure, share repurchases, and potential acquisitions. The Company's outlook is subject to various important cautionary factors, including risks and uncertainties related to the oil and natural gas industry, business conditions, international markets, international political climates, public health crises, such as the COVID-19 pandemic, and any related actions taken by businesses and governments.
